issues.title: Missing landmark regions

occurrences.current_value: Missing landmark regions: Missing header/banner landmark (use <header> or role='banner')

issues.why: Missing landmarks force screen reader users to listen to entire page to find main content.
issues.what: Missing expected landmarks: main, navigation, header, footer.
issues.recommendation: Add landmark regions: <main> for primary content, <nav> for navigation, <header> for header, <footer> for footer. Use ARIA roles as fallback

issues.title: Links with non-descriptive text
issues.why: Non-descriptive link text forces screen reader users to read surrounding context to understand link purpose.
issues.what: Links found with generic anchor text (click here, read more, here, etc.) or aria-label.
issues.recommendation: Use descriptive link text that makes sense out of context. Avoid 'click here', 'read more', 'here'. Use aria-label if visual design requires brief text

issues.title: Missing skip navigation link
issues.why: Without skip links, keyboard users must tab through all navigation to reach main content.
issues.what: No skip-to-content link found, or skip link not first focusable element.
issues.recommendation: Add a skip-to-content link as the first focusable element: Skip to main content

issues.title: Buttons missing accessible names
issues.why: Buttons without accessible names are announced as 'button' without indicating their function.
issues.what: Buttons found without accessible names (text, value, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title).
issues.recommendation: Ensure all buttons have accessible names: use text content for <button>, value for <input type=button>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute
